implementation.base: Frozen mesh-integrated-v1/work-app-v4; retains proven topology/source arena/lazy-canonical fallbacks and old capability probes. AJ01 absence uses unchanged legacy renderer. New same-ELF pairing measures its control overhead.
implementation.admission: Cached immutable own-slot VTX/TRI task, prepared eligible material, full uint16 UV origins, RNE/raw LOAD eligibility, cached 256-command VTX/TRI-only suffix proving all new slots overwritten before CPU reads. Every state/list/end/unknown command rejects. G_FOG alone is permitted when alpha resolves constant255.
implementation.jobs: Changed context runs and one12-word JOB packet in existing ordered ingress; original CPU pointers stay immutable for repair. No synchronous raw/preflight/ARM waits. Normal ring threshold; waits publish all prior jobs before waiting for completion.
implementation.legacy: Acquire once after all prior generated words reach common output; refresh shared context on new lease. Consecutive legacy LOADs and canonical readers reuse granted ticket. Next G_VTX copies survivors and drops overwritten rows; async admission releases lease only after that barrier. At frame end remaining lazy canonical rows are copied before release.
implementation.reset: Consumer reset preserves granted legacy ticket/raw view. App invalidates async sequence/context cache, retains only matching lease, cancels repair when token or epoch changes; full fabric reset also resets app CPU state. Unexpected lost legacy ownership faults visibly.
implementation.repair: Pure helper saves/restores FCSR, reads immutable job context/source or repair-owned raw view, emits only vertex/draw packets through separate head insertion. ACK precedes DATA/END. No renderer state restoration/reentrancy.
implementation.liveness: Ring/DMA/fence wait hooks, raw polling, display-list entries, acquire/source drain and pre-kernel flip-fence waits service repair. Source drain compares completed async sequence only and does not wait for its own held idle legacy lease.

structural_coverage.scope: Old frozen baseline trace; final shader exclusions and new app native outcomes may reduce coverage. No speed estimate.
